mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from t-2mo to t-1mo) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months (measured as UNRATE change from t-4mo to t-1mo) signals deteriorating labor market conditions and recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 132,000) combined with a weak housing market (HOUST < 500) signals economic imbalance where job growth fails to translate into consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 132000 and HOUST < 500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior month signals accelerating economic activity and reduced recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2009-05-15 is in the post-shock recovery phase following the 2008 financial crisis
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during the post-shock recovery regime when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over one month (measured as INDPRO change from t-2mo to t-1mo) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market strength exceeding 500 thousand units (HOUST > 500) signals robust consumer spending and economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth exceeding 0.5% (measured as GDPC1 growth from t-4mo to t-1mo) signals sustained economic expansion and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where quarterly GDP growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.2% over one month signals inflationary pressures that may trigger monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
